document: Crypto CSV Rescue hypothetical sample for one-owner paid pilot

metadata.author: One Cursor AI-assisted, one economic human owner
metadata.maximumIssues: one bounded transaction CSV discrepancy cluster

buyerDeliverableOnlyAfterWrittenConsent: Limited sanitized rows source-quality / duplicate suspicion table
Non-unique exchange-to-wallet counterpart candidates with uncertainty
Acquisition history gap questions, never invented cost basis
Evidence to collect from merchant-controlled sources
Summary of unresolved exceptions and explicit human review queue

cases.indication: Two source rows share the same invented export reference and event fields; investigate a duplicate import before removing either row.
cases.requiredEvidence: Original exchange export, whether an earlier API sync also imported that activity

cases.indication: A fictional withdrawal exists, but no clearly linked incoming row was supplied in the limited sample.
cases.requiredEvidence: Destination wallet/account activity, transfer timestamp, chain+token network, fees and merchant-authorized transfer identity

cases.indication: A fictional disposal has insufficient prior acquisition history in the provided bounded rows. Neither cost nor purchase price can be inferred.
cases.requiredEvidence: Original acquisition trade, earlier wallet/exchange history, actual trade fee records and independently established values

cases.indication: Two different fictional log indexes share a transaction reference. A shared transaction alone is NOT a duplicate economic event.
cases.requiredEvidence: The actual chain, token contract and each genuine token Transfer event log index

cases.indication: Invented gross withdrawal 1.500000 and net deposit 1.498000 differ by 0.002000 ETH; a fee is one possibility, not a fact.
cases.requiredEvidence: Original exchange withdrawal receipt with exact fee, receiving transfer event, contract+network and whether token tax applies

cases.indication: Two invented timestamps may represent one instant if the first was KST (+09:00); the original CSV lacks an explicit offset.
cases.requiredEvidence: Original export documentation specifying timezone, date precision and row/source identity

cases.indication: Matching a displayed ticker is insufficient when network ID and issuer token contract are unknown or different.
cases.requiredEvidence: Canonical network ID, token contract, recipient and verified actual transfer log for both records

cases.indication: Two invented candidate deposits share a nearby time and amount. That is not enough to assert self-transfer ownership.
cases.requiredEvidence: Merchant/customer-approved account ownership, withdrawal ID, genuine tx event identity and fee accounting

disclaimers: Every ID, date, quantity and finding is invented; none was observed in a buyer ledger.
This is a format sample, not evidence of working full importer or a real paid case.
No public upload or wallet/seed/signature/payment authorizations; actual data requires a separate written authorization and appropriate protected exchange.
Never manufacture missing cost basis, price, transaction confirmation, exchange custody, tax treatment or customer identity.
Tax filings, professional accounting/legal advice and tax outcome assurance are explicitly excluded.
